school.address: 123 Education Lane, Knowledge Park, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

campusLife.title: Innovate 2025: The Annual AI Hackathon
campusLife.description: Join the 24-hour coding challenge. Form teams and build a project focused on AI and machine learning. Great prizes and internship opportunities. Sponsored by the CS Department.

campusLife.title: Guest Lecture: Quantum Mechanics & Its Future
campusLife.description: Dr. Aruna Singh from the National Physics Laboratory will be giving a guest lecture on the future of quantum computing. All science (Physics, Chemistry) students are encouraged to attend.

campusLife.title: Robotics Club: New Member Auditions
campusLife.description: The Robotics Club is looking for new engineers, programmers, and designers for the upcoming national competition. Sign up for an audition slot. This is perfect for problem-solving enthusiasts.

campusLife.title: Annual Cultural Fest 'Spectrum' - Volunteer Sign-ups
campusLife.description: Spectrum is back! We need volunteers for event management, stage design, and hospitality. A great way to get involved and meet new people.

campusLife.title: Career Services Workshop: Building Your Resume
campusLife.description: The placement cell is hosting a workshop on how to build a professional resume and prepare for technical interviews. Mandatory for all final-year students.

campusLife.title: Basketball Team Tryouts
campusLife.description: The university basketball team is holding tryouts for all new and returning players. Show us what you've got! All students welcome.

campusLife.title: Workshop: Introduction to Python for Data Science
campusLife.description: A 3-day workshop on the fundamentals of Python, Pandas, and Matplotlib. No prior coding experience required. Perfect for students interested in data analysis or AI.

campusLife.title: Library Closure for Maintenance
campusLife.description: The central library will be closed this weekend (Oct 25-26) for system upgrades. Please issue any required books beforehand.
